verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹ֣את בֵּֽית־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַנִּקְרָאִים֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִמֵּ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יָצָ֑אוּ הַֽנִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים׀ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וּבֵאלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַזְכִּ֔ירוּ לֹ֥א בֶאֱמֶ֖ת וְלֹ֥א בִצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- zōṯ bêṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ han·niq·rā·’îm bə·šêm yiś·rā·’êl ū·mim·mê yə·hū·ḏāh yā·ṣā·’ū han·niš·bā·‘îm bə·šêm Yah·weh ū·ḇê·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl yaz·kî·rū lō ḇe·’ĕ·meṯ wə·lō ḇiṣ·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: Listen to this O house of Jacob you who are called by the name of Israel who have descended from the line of Judah who swear by the name of the LORD who invoke the God of Israel but not in truth or righteousness
verses.literalPt: Ouve isto, casa de Jacó, vós os que vos chamais do nome de Israel e saístes das águas de Judá; que jurais pelo nome de Jeová e fazeis menção do Deus de Israel, porém não em verdade nem em justiça.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מֵעִ֤יר הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ נִקְרָ֔אוּ וְעַל־ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִסְמָ֑כוּ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- mê·‘îr haq·qō·ḏeš niq·rā·’ū wə·‘al- ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl nis·mā·ḵū Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: who indeed call yourselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel the LORD of Hosts is His name
verses.literalPt: Pois eles se chamam da cidade santa e se firmam sobre o Deus de Israel; Jeová dos Exércitos é o seu nome.

verses.original: הָרִֽאשֹׁנוֹת֙ מֵאָ֣ז הִגַּ֔דְתִּי וּמִפִּ֥י יָצְא֖וּ וְאַשְׁמִיעֵ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם עָשִׂ֖יתִי וַתָּבֹֽאנָה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ri·šō·nō·wṯ mê·’āz hig·gaḏ·tî ū·mip·pî yā·ṣə·’ū wə·’aš·mî·‘êm piṯ·’ōm ‘ā·śî·ṯî wat·tā·ḇō·nāh
verses.literal: I foretold the former things long ago they came out of My mouth and I proclaimed them Suddenly I acted and they came to pass
verses.literalPt: Há muito anunciei as coisas passadas; e da minha boca é que saíram, e as fiz ouvir. De repente, as pus por obra, e elas aconteceram.

verses.original: מִדַּעְתִּ֕י כִּ֥י קָשֶׁ֖ה אָ֑תָּה וְגִ֤יד בַּרְזֶל֙ עָרְפֶּ֔ךָ וּמִצְחֲךָ֖ נְחוּשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: mid·da‘·tî kî qā·šeh ’āt·tāh wə·ḡîḏ bar·zel ‘ā·rə·pe·ḵā ū·miṣ·ḥă·ḵā nə·ḥū·šāh
verses.literal: For I knew that you . . . are stubborn your neck is iron and your forehead is bronze
verses.literalPt: Porque eu sabia que és obstinado, que a tua cerviz é um nervo de ferro, e a tua testa, de bronze;

verses.original: וָאַגִּ֤יד לְךָ֙ מֵאָ֔ז בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֑יךָ פֶּן־ תֹּאמַר֙ עָצְבִּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ם וּפִסְלִ֥י וְנִסְכִּ֖י צִוָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ag·gîḏ lə·ḵā mê·’āz bə·ṭe·rem tā·ḇō·w hiš·ma‘·tî·ḵā pen- tō·mar ‘ā·ṣə·bî ‘ā·śām ū·p̄is·lî wə·nis·kî ṣiw·wām
verses.literal: Therefore I declared it to you long ago I announced it before it came to pass so that you could not claim My idol has done this my carved image and molten god has ordained it
verses.literalPt: por isso, há muito eu as anunciei; antes que acontecessem, eu as manifestei, para que não dissesses: O meu ídolo é o que fez essas coisas, e a minha imagem esculpida e a minha imagem fundida as ordenaram.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֤עְתָּֽ חֲזֵה֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְאַתֶּ֖ם הֲל֣וֹא תַגִּ֑ידוּ הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֤יךָ חֲדָשׁוֹת֙ מֵעַ֔תָּה וּנְצֻר֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tā ḥă·zêh kul·lāh wə·’at·tem hă·lō·w ṯag·gî·ḏū hiš·ma‘·tî·ḵā ḥă·ḏā·šō·wṯ mê·‘at·tāh ū·nə·ṣu·rō·wṯ wə·lō yə·ḏa‘·tām
verses.literal: You have heard these things look at them all Will you not acknowledge them? From now on I will tell you of new things hidden things unknown to you . . .
verses.literalPt: Já o tens ouvido; olha para tudo isso; acaso, vós não o anunciareis? Desde agora, te mostro coisas novas, coisas escondidas, que não sabias.

verses.original: עַתָּ֤ה נִבְרְאוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מֵאָ֔ז וְלִפְנֵי־ י֖וֹם וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתָּ֑ם פֶּן־ תֹּאמַ֖ר הִנֵּ֥ה יְדַעְתִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh niḇ·rə·’ū wə·lō mê·’āz wə·lip̄·nê- yō·wm wə·lō šə·ma‘·tām pen- tō·mar hin·nêh yə·ḏa‘·tîn
verses.literal: They are created now and not long ago you have not heard of them before today So you cannot claim I already knew them
verses.literalPt: São criadas agora e não de há muito; e, antes deste dia, não as ouviste, para que não dissesses: Eis que eu já sabia.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם לֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ גַּ֚ם לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתָּ גַּ֕ם מֵאָ֖ז לֹא־ פִתְּחָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ בָּג֣וֹד תִּבְגּ֔וֹד וּפֹשֵׁ֥עַ מִבֶּ֖טֶן קֹ֥רָא לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: gam lō- šā·ma‘·tā gam lō yā·ḏa‘·tā gam mê·’āz lō- p̄it·tə·ḥāh ’ā·zə·ne·ḵā kî yā·ḏa‘·tî bā·ḡō·wḏ tiḇ·gō·wḏ ū·p̄ō·šê·a‘ mib·be·ṭen qō·rā lāḵ
verses.literal: You have never heard . . . you have never understood . . . for a long time your ears have not been open For I knew how deceitful you are . . . you have been called a rebel from birth
verses.literalPt: Tu nem as ouviste, nem as soubeste, nem há muito que se lhe abriu o teu ouvido; porque eu sabia que procedeste mui perfidamente e foste chamado transgressor desde o ventre.

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִי֙ אַאֲרִ֣יךְ אַפִּ֔י וּתְהִלָּתִ֖י אֶחֱטָם־ לָ֑ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הַכְרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an šə·mî ’a·’ă·rîḵ ’ap·pî ū·ṯə·hil·lā·ṯî ’e·ḥĕ·ṭām- lāḵ lə·ḇil·tî haḵ·rî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: For the sake of My name I will delay My wrath for the sake of My praise I will restrain it so that you will not be cut off
verses.literalPt: Por amor do meu nome, dilatarei a minha ira e, por causa do meu louvor, me refrearei para contigo, a fim de que eu não te extermine.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה צְרַפְתִּ֖יךָ וְלֹ֣א בְכָ֑סֶף בְּחַרְתִּ֖יךָ בְּכ֥וּר עֹֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ṣə·rap̄·tî·ḵā wə·lō ḇə·ḵā·sep̄ bə·ḥar·tî·ḵā bə·ḵūr ‘ō·nî
verses.literal: See I have refined you but not as silver I have tested you in the furnace of affliction
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu te purifiquei, porém não como a prata; escolhi-te na fornalha da aflição.

verses.original: לְמַעֲנִ֧י לְמַעֲנִ֛י אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣יךְ יֵחָ֑ל וּכְבוֹדִ֖י לְאַחֵ֥ר לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘ă·nî lə·ma·‘ă·nî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh kî ’êḵ yê·ḥāl ū·ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏî lə·’a·ḥêr lō- ’et·tên
verses.literal: For My own sake My very own sake I will act for how can I let Myself be defamed I will not yield My glory to another
verses.literalPt: Por amor de mim, por amor de mim, o farei; pois como seria o meu nome profanado? A minha glória, não a darei a outrem.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־ הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ ’ê·lay ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yiś·rā·’êl mə·qō·rā·’î ’ă·nî- hū ’ă·nî ri·šō·wn ’ap̄ ’ă·nî ’a·ḥă·rō·wn
verses.literal: Listen to Me O Jacob and Israel whom I have called I am He I am the first and I am . . . the last
verses.literalPt: Escuta-me, ó Jacó, e tu, ó Israel, a quem eu chamei; eu sou o mesmo, eu sou o primeiro, também eu sou o último.

verses.original: אַף־ יָדִי֙ יָ֣סְדָה אֶ֔רֶץ וִֽימִינִ֖י טִפְּחָ֣ה שָׁמָ֑יִם קֹרֵ֥א אֲנִ֛י אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יַעַמְד֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- yā·ḏî yā·sə·ḏāh ’e·reṣ wî·mî·nî ṭip·pə·ḥāh šā·mā·yim qō·rê ’ă·nî ’ă·lê·hem ya·‘am·ḏū yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Surely My own hand founded the earth and My right hand spread out the heavens when I . . . summon them they stand up together
verses.literalPt: A minha mão é também a que fundou a terra, e a minha destra é a que estendeu os céus. Quando eu os chamar, eles se apresentarão juntos.

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֤וּ כֻלְּכֶם֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔עוּ מִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם הִגִּ֣יד אֶת־ אֵ֑לֶּה יְהוָ֣ה אֲהֵב֔וֹ יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה חֶפְצוֹ֙ בְּבָבֶ֔ל וּזְרֹע֖וֹ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū ḵul·lə·ḵem ū·šă·mā·‘ū mî ḇā·hem hig·gîḏ ’eṯ- ’êl·leh Yah·weh ’ă·hê·ḇōw ya·‘ă·śeh ḥep̄·ṣōw bə·ḇā·ḇel ū·zə·rō·‘ōw kaś·dîm
verses.literal: Come together all of you and listen Which of the idols has foretold these things The LORD’s chosen ally will carry out His desire against Babylon and His arm will be against the Chaldeans
verses.literalPt: Ajuntai-vos, todos vós, e ouvi; qual dentre eles anunciou essas coisas? Aquele a quem Jeová amou executará a sua vontade contra Babilônia, e o seu braço estará sobre os caldeus.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י אֲנִ֛י דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אַף־ קְרָאתִ֑יו הֲבִיאֹתִ֖יו וְהִצְלִ֥יחַ דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’ă·nî dib·bar·tî ’ap̄- qə·rā·ṯîw hă·ḇî·’ō·ṯîw wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ dar·kōw
verses.literal: I even I have spoken yes I have called him I have brought him and he will succeed in his mission
verses.literalPt: Eu, eu tenho falado; também já o chamei. Eu o trouxe, e o seu caminho será próspero.

verses.original: קִרְב֧וּ אֵלַ֣י שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹ֗את לֹ֤א מֵרֹאשׁ֙ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי מֵעֵ֥ת הֱיוֹתָ֖הּ שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי וְעַתָּ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה שְׁלָחַ֖נִי וְרוּחֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: qir·ḇū ’ê·lay šim·‘ū- zōṯ lō mê·rōš bas·sê·ṯer dib·bar·tî mê·‘êṯ hĕ·yō·w·ṯāh šām ’ā·nî wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥa·nî wə·rū·ḥōw
verses.literal: Come near to Me and listen to this From the beginning I have not spoken in secret from the time it happened I was there And now the Lord GOD has sent me accompanied by His Spirit
verses.literalPt: Chegai-vos perto de mim e ouvi isto; desde o princípio, não falei às escondidas; desde o tempo em que aconteceu, estava eu ali. Agora, o Senhor Jeová me enviou, e o seu espírito.

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְךָ֖ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ מְלַמֶּדְךָ֣ לְהוֹעִ֔יל מַדְרִֽיכֲךָ֖ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ תֵּלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh gō·’al·ḵā qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mə·lam·meḏ·ḵā lə·hō·w·‘îl maḏ·rî·ḵă·ḵā bə·ḏe·reḵ tê·lêḵ
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer the Holy One of Israel I am the LORD your God who teaches you for your benefit who directs you in the way you should go
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová, teu Redentor, o Santo de Israel: Eu sou Jeová, teu Deus, que te ensino o que é útil, que te guio pelo caminho em que deves andar.

verses.original: ל֥וּא הִקְשַׁ֖בְתָּ לְמִצְוֺתָ֑י וַיְהִ֤י כַנָּהָר֙ שְׁלוֹמֶ֔ךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֖ כְּגַלֵּ֥י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lū hiq·šaḇ·tā lə·miṣ·wō·ṯāy way·hî ḵan·nā·hār šə·lō·w·me·ḵā wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā kə·ḡal·lê hay·yām
verses.literal: If only you had paid attention to My commandments your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like waves of the sea
verses.literalPt: Oxalá que tivesses atendido aos meus mandamentos! Então, a tua paz teria sido como um rio, e a tua justiça, como as ondas do mar;

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י כַחוֹל֙ זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וְצֶאֱצָאֵ֥י מֵעֶ֖יךָ כִּמְעֹתָ֑יו לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֧ת וְֽלֹא־ יִשָּׁמֵ֛ד שְׁמ֖וֹ מִלְּפָנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵa·ḥō·wl zar·‘e·ḵā wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’ê mê·‘e·ḵā kim·‘ō·ṯāw lō- yik·kā·rêṯ wə·lō- yiš·šā·mêḏ šə·mōw mil·lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: Your descendants would have been as countless as the sand and your offspring . . . as numerous as its grains their name would never be cut off . . . or eliminated from My presence
verses.literalPt: teria sido a tua posteridade como a areia, e os que procedem das tuas entranhas, como os seus grãos; não havia de ser o seu nome cortado, nem destruído de diante de mim.

verses.original: צְא֣וּ מִבָּבֶל֮ בִּרְח֣וּ מִכַּשְׂדִּים֒ בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּ֗ה הַגִּ֤ידוּ הַשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ זֹ֔את הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ עַד־ קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ אִמְר֕וּ גָּאַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה עַבְדּ֥וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ṣə·’ū mib·bā·ḇel bir·ḥū mik·kaś·dîm bə·qō·wl rin·nāh hag·gî·ḏū haš·mî·‘ū zōṯ hō·w·ṣî·’ū·hā ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ ’im·rū gā·’al Yah·weh ‘aḇ·dōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Leave Babylon Flee from the Chaldeans Declare it with a shout of joy proclaim it let it go out to the ends of the earth saying The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob
verses.literalPt: Saí de Babilônia, fugi dos caldeus. Anunciai com voz de júbilo, fazei ouvir isto e levai-o até os fins da terra; dizei: Jeová remiu ao seu servo Jacó.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א צָמְא֗וּ בָּחֳרָבוֹת֙ הֽוֹלִיכָ֔ם מַ֥יִם מִצּ֖וּר הִזִּ֣יל לָ֑מוֹ וַיִּ֨בְקַע־ צ֔וּר וַיָּזֻ֖בוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṣā·mə·’ū bā·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ hō·w·lî·ḵām ma·yim miṣ·ṣūr hiz·zîl lā·mōw way·yiḇ·qa‘- ṣūr way·yā·zu·ḇū mā·yim
verses.literal: They did not thirst when He led them through the deserts He made water flow for them from the rock He split the rock and water gushed out
verses.literalPt: Eles não tinham sede quando os conduzia pelos desertos; da pedra lhes fez correr águas; fendeu a pedra, e as águas correram.

verses.original: אֵ֣ין שָׁל֔וֹם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לָרְשָׁעִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ên šā·lō·wm ’ā·mar Yah·weh lā·rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: There is no peace says the LORD for the wicked
verses.literalPt: Para os ímpios não há paz, diz Jeová.
